'''Media''' was an [[City/Legends|urban]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Media system/Legends|Media system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. It was connected to the [[Lucaya system]] by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Lucaya Cross]]. Media's economy relied on light industry, and several prominent manufacturers of [[Repulsorlift generator/Legends|repulsorlift units]] and related accessories were based there. A substantial portion of the world's population consisted of immigrants of the [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Media was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-4.<ref name="TEA" />
